name: Turn commit messages into release notes with an agent skill
description: A chat agent with the Skills Tool. When you paste commit messages, it loads the release-notes skill, runs the skill's script to group conventional commits by type, and writes short, user-facing release notes with new features, fixes and performance changes. The skill's SKILL.md and script are in a note on the canvas, ready to upload.
shortDescription: A chat agent loads a release-notes skill on demand and runs its script to write release notes.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the Skills Tool, which loads a skill only when a request matches it
Skill script that groups conventional commits by type in a sandbox
Canvas note with the full SKILL.md and script to create the skill
Chat Memory so you can refine the notes in follow-up messages
prerequisites: The release-notes skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the files in the canvas note
idealFor: Java and other software teams that want release notes drafted from their commit log, and anyone learning how agent skills work.
steps: Trigger: a message arrives in the workflow chat.
Write release notes: the AI Agent loads the release-notes skill, calls its group_commits script tool and writes the notes.
Reply: the agent's answer is sent back to the chat.
